name: PHQ-9 (Patient Health Questionnaire-9)
description: A 9-item self-administered depression screening tool based on DSM criteria. Scores 0–27 with validated cut-points for mild, moderate, moderately severe, and severe depression.
reputation: Most widely used depression screening tool globally; free in public domain; validated in hundreds of studies.
notes: Self-report susceptible to social desirability; not diagnostic on its own.
